fields.name: Components
fields.about: Filter components to apply to quota entities.

fields.name: EntityType
fields.about: The entity type that the filter component applies to.

fields.name: MatchType
fields.about: How to match the entity {0 = exact name, 1 = default name, 2 = any specified name}.

fields.name: Match
fields.about: The string to match against, or null if unused for the match type.

fields.name: Strict
fields.about: Whether the match is strict, i.e. should exclude entities with unspecified entity types.
